```{r}

install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sentimentr"))

library(tidyverse)
library(sentimentr)
```



```{r}


responses <- tibble(
  id = 1:6,
  response = c(
    "The trail was beautiful and I had a wonderful time.",
    "The trail was poorly maintained and disappointing.",
    "The scenery was great but the crowds were terrible.",
    "The trail was challenging, but I really enjoyed it.",
    "I would not recommend this trail.",
    "I walked approximately three miles."
  )
)

```
